review_notes: Fresh full38421B original and40064B organized versions read separately for this primary review, despite an earlier context read. Every source declaration, attached document, simp attribute, private modifier, equation and theorem proof is retained exactly.

XOR vectors and coordinate flips form a complete component. Derivatives/localJacobian and the original Quantizer wrapper form another. The entire differential/SAC counting component retains both private pairing helpers and their complete consumers; nonzero delta and injectivity assumptions are never weakened. Width1 strict SAC obstruction is exact.

SAC marginal rational bounds and both score definitions/proofs remain together with every private bias/variance helper. StrictSAC is exact twice-count equality and rational-half equivalence; both scores use the written n=0→1 convention. Scaled Bernoulli variance is a rational formula, not a newly constructed random-variable model or joint independence result.

Hamming weight/support equivalence, choose counts, propagation histograms/normalization, complete first-moment equations and injective zero-fiber result stay whole, with the private support equivalence local. Fixed-edge binomial mass formulas and conditioning/marginal-bias algebra form an independent component; normalization and the exact positive-n/positive-k hypotheses are preserved. No ensemble construction, edge independence or sampling law is added merely from the commentary.

Identity bijection, exact derivatives/counts/zero scores and localJacobian image-cardinality counterexample remain whole, including their private singleton-image proof. The separate sign-correlation component preserves only the three stated definitions and the warning about uncentered correlation: no independence theorem is invented.

All eight same-source components retain namespace BitMatrix.Dynamics.Avalanche and exact original project/Mathlib imports. Only explicit own-version public companion imports are added. Private helpers and every same-source caller stay together; there is no new legacy self-import, provider alias or namespace/type replacement. Distinct historical names are not admitted together to an umbrella.
